title: Take the tour
note: The guided tour of one path through the City. The tour only opens screens and points at controls; it never changes a record. Each step names the walkthrough step of the same path.

steps.title: Match the café to its owner
steps.caption: The steward assistant prepares a recommendation and the Data Steward records the decision. The identity and the payer account must both be cleared before a reviewer may approve the case.

steps.title: Let the agent route the case
steps.caption: The intake agent reads each new case and routes it to the right queue. It never decides: a person does that.

steps.title: Run the checks and approve the case
steps.caption: Open the case of the café, run the application checks and record the decision with its reason. The identity and the payer account must be cleared first.

steps.title: Pay the fee
steps.caption: The fee is assessed on the case, the receipt from the old finance account is allocated to it and the assessment is reconciled. A permit is issued only at a 0.00 balance.

steps.title: Issue the permit
steps.caption: Deciding and issuing are separate. The permit is issued from the case once the finance position is exact, and the issued artifact never changes afterwards.

steps.title: Find it as a resident
steps.caption: The public record shows the permit, the parcel and the outcome. It never shows a homeowner's name, documents or fees.

steps.title: Apply for a permit
steps.caption: The applicant starts here: pick the project you need a permit for. The form asks only the questions that project needs.

steps.title: Check the application before it is sent
steps.caption: Press Check my application to see what the published rules say about the answers, and fix what the panel lists under Must fix before the application is sent.

steps.title: Let the agent route the application
steps.caption: The intake agent reads each new application and routes it to the right queue. An application that breaks a rule waits in Early resolution, and the Router line gives the reason.

steps.title: Track the application
steps.caption: The resident follows the application on the City of Acme website and reads what the City has recorded so far.

steps.title: Check the record of the decision
steps.caption: Every action is recorded. Filter the log for the recorded permit decision and open its details.

steps.title: See the city at a glance
steps.caption: The City view: the counts, the map, and the definition printed beside each figure.

steps.title: Try a what if on a fee change
steps.caption: A what-if runs a change over the cases and writes down what it would do. It decides nothing and changes nothing.

steps.title: Watch the video
steps.caption: The video shows the same journey in under three minutes. Every record in the app is fictional.

steps.title: Read the permit life cycle
steps.caption: The life cycle lists every status and every move, and it names who makes each move. An agent only routes cases, a person decides and issues.

steps.title: See what the City plans next
steps.caption: The help hub lists the guides, the glossary and the technical documents, including the plan for assistants through MCP.
